description.text: The third Black & White set, released on 16 November 2011 with 102 cards: 101 and a secret Meowth. It brought in Victini, Kyurem, Druddigon and Hydreigon, the Restored Pokémon Tirtouga and Archen, played only through certain Items, and N, the first full-art Trainer. Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion got full-art cards, and with it every fifth-generation Pokémon had a card but the event Pokémon Keldeo, Meloetta and Genesect. Its theme decks are Fast Daze and Furious Knights.
